headline: Port Congestion and Border Delays Impair Nigerian Export Drive
summary: Nigerian exporters face major operational hurdles due to port congestion and average border delays of 53 hours, threatening commercial benefits under the AfCFTA trade agreement.
why: Infrastructure bottlenecks in West Africa's largest economy reduce the export competitiveness of agricultural and industrial goods.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Cross-border transit delays increase logistics overheads and diminish export revenues.
